chunks: And Abu Ayyub said: Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said:
Whoever swears by Allah, let him speak the truth; and whoever does not speak the truth has nothing to do with Allah in any way.
And whoever is sworn to by Allah, let him be content; and whoever is not content has nothing to do with Allah in any way.

key_terms.بِٱللَّهِ: by Allah; invoking the divine name in an oath
key_terms.حُلِفَ لَهُ: an oath was made to him
key_terms.فَلْيَرْضَ: then let him be content and accept it

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about swearing by Allah and accepting an oath?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches truthfulness when invoking Allah in an oath and warns strongly against false swearing. It also teaches that when someone swears by Allah, the other party should accept it with contentment, showing reverence for the divine name and proper ethical conduct in social dealings.
